craftStand: For me creative work is not chance but craft — trained on the image, thought through in motion.
craft1Text: My roots are in comics and storyboard art — a trained eye for timing, visual flow and hierarchy in every piece.
craft1Caption: Illustration: a hand-drawn storyboard sheet with six panels — sketches of a bottle, arrows and scribbled notes.
craft2Text: Movement brings a brand's personality to life: product features become benefits people can actually feel.
craft2Caption: Illustration: the same bottle as a 3D wireframe in the viewport — axis gizmo, control points and a golden motion path.
craft3Text: The same narrative precision — whether it is a quick social post or a high-end brand campaign.
craft3Caption: Illustration: the finished bottle in warm, directional light with a golden rim highlight.
